nodes.notes: Notifica 1h antes do horário de upload (19h BRT)

parameters.query: SELECT gc.id, LEFT(gc.title, 70) AS titulo, gc.score, ROUND(gc.end_time - gc.start_time, 0) AS duracao_s, sc.channel_name AS canal FROM generated_clips gc JOIN source_videos sv ON gc.source_video_id = sv.id JOIN source_channels sc ON sv.channel_id = sc.id WHERE gc.status = 'pending' ORDER BY gc.score DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_hoje FROM generated_clips WHERE status = 'published' AND DATE(published_at) = CURDATE()
